sos.title: Ukuphepha le-SOS
sos.smsBody: SOS. Ngidinga usizo phakathi kohambo lwePoolora.
sos.micBody: Vumela iPoolora ukusebenzisa imayikhrofoni kuzilungiselelo zefoni yakho ukuze irekhode ngesikhathi se-SOS.
sos.safeConfirmBody: Bazakulokhu bekufonela ukuze bahlole, besebevala isaziso. Abantu bakho bokuthintwa esimeni esiphuthumayo bazatshelwa ukuthi uphephile.
sos.locationAllow: Vumela ukufinyelela endaweni ukuze wabelane ngokuthi ungaphi.

active.title: Isaziso se-SOS siyasebenza
active.sub: Iqembu lePoolora lezokuphepha lazisiwe njalo liyabona ukuthi ungaphi.
active.retryingSub: Akukaxhumeki. Siyaqhubeka sizama ngemva kwemizuzwana embalwa. Fonela {{number}}, kumbe uthumele umlayezo kubantu bakho usebenzisa ifoni yakho.
active.closedCancelled: Ukhanselile isaziso. Abantu bakho abazange batshelwe.
active.safeSub: Uthe uphephile. Iqembu lezokuphepha lizakufonela ukuze lihlole, beselivala isaziso.
active.acknowledgedSub: Iqembu lezokuphepha selisitholile isaziso sakho njalo lizakufonela. Gcina ifoni yakho iseduze lawe.

sos.textingIn: Kuzathunyelwa umlayezo kubantu bakho bokuthintwa esimeni esiphuthumayo ngemva kwemizuzwana engu-{{seconds}}
sos.sentTo: Umlayezo lendawo yakho ebukhoma kuthunyelwe ku:
sos.noContactsToText: Awulabantu bokuthintwa esimeni esiphuthumayo ongabathumela umlayezo. Bangeze ngemva kwalokhu ukuze baziswe ngesikhathi esizayo.
sos.texting: Kuthunyelwa umlayezo kubantu bakho bokuthintwa esimeni esiphuthumayo…
sos.textFailed: Asenelisanga ukuthumela umlayezo kubantu bakho bokuthintwa esimeni esiphuthumayo. Bafonele, kumbe ubathumele umlayezo usebenzisa ifoni yakho.
sos.lowBattery: Ibhethri {{percent}}%. Nxa ifoni yakho icima, iqembu lezokuphepha ligcina indawo yakho yokucina njalo lisengabona amanye amafoni alohambweni.
sos.textFromPhone: Thumela umlayezo kubantu bami ngefoni yami

sos.holdLabel: SOS. Cindezela ubambe imizuzwana emi-3 ukuze wazise iqembu lezokuphepha
sos.holdHint: Abantu bakho bokuthintwa esimeni esiphuthumayo bathunyelwa umlayezo ngemva kwemizuzwana eyi-10 ngaphandle nxa ukhansela
sos.needsRide: Izaziso ze-SOS zisebenza phakathi kohambo oluqinisekisiweyo. Nxa usengozini khathesi, fonela {{number}}.
sos.holdInstructions: Bamba imizuzwana emi-3. Iqembu lezokuphepha laziswa masinyane; abantu bakho bokuthintwa esimeni esiphuthumayo ngemva kwemizuzwana eyi-10, ngaphandle nxa ukhansela.
sos.fakeCallHint: Ifoni yakho iyakhala ngemva kwemizuzwana embalwa, ukuze ube lesizatho sokusuka
sos.audioBody: Kuvaliwe ngaphandle nxa ukuvula. Ngesikhathi se-SOS ifoni yakho irekhoda ekuzwayo njalo ikuthumele eqenjini lePoolora lezokuphepha kuphela, ngeziqephu zomzuzu.
sos.contactsEmpty: Faka abantu okufanele bathole umlayezo lendawo yakho nxa uvusa i-SOS.

video.title: Bonisa iqembu lezokuphepha

video.noSound: Ifoni yakho irekhoda umsindo we-SOS yakho, ngakho ividiyo ihamba ingelamsindo.

identity.intro: Uhambo lwabesifazana kuphela ngolwabesifazana esesiqinisekise ubuwena babo, ukuze kungabi lomuntu ongena nje ngokuthi ungowesifazana. Thumela isithombe se-ID yesizwe, iphasiphothi kumbe ilayisensi yokutshayela, kanye le-selfie. Umlawuli wePoolora uhlola ukuthi i-selfie ngeyakho yini, kuvame ukuthatha ilanga elilodwa. I-ID itshengisa ukuthi ungubani; ubulili bakho yilobo ophila ngabo. Izithombe zibonwa liqembu lethu kuphela njalo zisuswa masinyane nxa sesenze isinqumo.

help.requestsYouSendAppearHere: Izicelo ozithumelayo zibonakala lapha lezimpendulo zethu.

t1.a1: Nxa umtshayeli esemukela isicelo sakho. Abatshayeli balamahora ayi-6 okuphendula; isicelo esingaphendulwanga ngesikhathi, kumbe uhambo selusukile, siyaphela njalo yonke inkokhelo iyabuyiselwa.
t1.a2: Isicelo esibhadelwe nge-EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks kumbe ikhadi esingabhadelwanga phakathi kwemizuzu eyi-15 siyakhanselwa. Nxa inkokhelo iphumelela ngemva kwalokho, ingena ku-wallet yakho yePoolora. Nxa imali isiphumile ku-akhawunti yakho kodwa ingekho ku-wallet, vula isicelo ngaphansi kwe-Inkokhelo ngezansi ukuze siyilandelele.
t1.a3: Umtshayeli engakamukeli, ubuyiselwa yonke. Ngemva kwalokho, ngokujayelekileyo: yonke imali nxa kusele amahora angu-24 kumbe ngaphezulu, ingxenye kusukela emahoreni ama-2, njalo akula ngemva kwalokho. Ukukhansela phakathi kwemizuzu engu-30 umtshayeli esemukele kumahhala, nxa uhambo lusasele ihora kumbe ngaphezulu. Uhlelo lukutshengisa imali eqondileyo ungakaqinisekisi. Nxa umtshayeli etshintsha isikhathi kumbe ekhansela, ubuyiselwa yonke imali.
t1.a4: Iya ku-wallet yakho yePoolora masinyane, kungelani lokuthi ubhadele njani. Yisebenzise kuhambo lwakho olulandelayo, kumbe uyikhiphe iye ku-EcoCash, OneMoney kumbe InnBucks ngaphansi kweZilungiselelo, Wallet; umuntu uthumela izimali ezikhitshwayo, kuvame ukuba phakathi kwelanga elilodwa lomsebenzi.
t1.a5: Yebo, nxa i-ZiG inikezwa esikrinini sokubhadala. Intengo ibekwa ngama-US dollars njalo iguqulwe ngesilinganiso esiboniswa ungakabhadali.

t2.a1: Esikrinini sohambo, thepha Yabelana ngohambo. Loba ngubani olesixhumanisi angalandela imota ngaphandle kohlelo kuze kudlule ihora ngemva kokufika kwakho.
t2.a2: Bamba inkinobho ye-SOS imizuzwana emi-3. Iqembu lePoolora lezokuphepha laziswa masinyane njalo liyabona ukuthi ungaphi. Ngemva kwemizuzwana eyi-10 abantu bakho bokuthintwa esimeni esiphuthumayo bathola umlayezo olesixhumanisi sendawo yakho ebukhoma, ngaphandle nxa ukhansela ngoba ucindezele ngephutha. Nxa usengozini, fonela lo{{number}} (amapholisa {{police}}, i-ambulensi {{ambulance}}).
t2.q3: Kuthiwani nxa ngingela signal kumbe GPS?
t2.a3: Isaziso sisahamba: nxa i-GPS ingatholi indawo sisebenzisa indawo yokucina yemota. Nxa kungeladatha nhlobo, uhlelo luqhubeka luzama njalo lunikeza ukuthumela umlayezo kubantu bakho ngefoni yakho lokufonela inombolo yezimo eziphuthumayo.
t2.a4: Kuhambo olude siyakuhlola ngemva kwemizuzu engu-30. Nxa ungaphenduli kabili, iqembu lethu lezokuphepha liyaziswa, njalo nxa uqhubeka ungaphenduli phakathi kwemizuzu emi-5 sithumela umlayezo kubantu bakho bokuthintwa esimeni esiphuthumayo.
t2.a5: Nxa umtshayeli ekhansela, ubuyiselwa yonke imali ngokuzenzakalela. Nxa engazange afike, thepha uhambo ku-Uhambo lwami ubusukhetha Bika inkinga.

t3.a1: Masinyane ngemva kohambo, kumbe muva ku-Uhambo lwami; uhambo ongakalulinganisi lumakwa ukuthi Linganisa. Izilinganiso ziyavalwa ngemva kwamalanga angu-7 ngemva kohambo. Ukubuyekezwa okubhaliweyo kubonakala ngemva kokuhlolwa liqembu lethu.
t3.a2: Ku-Uhambo lwami, thepha uhambo ubusukhetha Irisidi. Ungayithumela kuwe nge-imeyili futhi.
t3.a3: Thepha uhambo ku-Uhambo lwami ubusukhetha Bika inkinga. Iqembu lethu liyihlola phakathi kwamahora angu-48 kusiya ku-72 lisebenzisa ingxoxo yohambo, inkokhelo lomzila.

t4.a1: Sihlola ilayisensi yakho, ukubhaliswa kwemota le-insurance phakathi kwamahora angu-48. Nxa kukhona okungacacanga siyakucela ukuthi ulayishe lowo mbhalo futhi.
t4.a2: Siphakamisa intengo sisebenzisa ibanga lemota yakho, singeze kancane ngesikhathi sokuhamba emsebenzini lalapho isidingo siphezulu. Ungakhetha loba yini ephakathi kuka-30% kuyo.
t4.a3: Imibhalo evunyiweyo, uhambo olungu-20, isilinganiso esingu-4.7 kumbe ngaphezulu kubagibeli okungenani abangu-10, ukukhansela okulutshwana, amalanga angu-90 lathi kanye lerekhodi elihlanzekileyo. Iphrofayili yakho itshengisa intuthuko yakho.
t4.a4: Ingxenye yakho yemali yohambo iyafakwa nxa uqeda uhambo. Izitatimende zenyanga zisesikrinini seMali oyitholileyo.

impact.method1: Kuhambo ngalunye olwabelwanwayo sibala ingxenye yomzila womgibeli. Nxa ebetshayela yedwa, imota ejayelekileyo ikhipha cishe {{kg}} kg ye-CO₂ ngekhilomitha. Ngokubalelana, ubhekana kuphela lengxenye yesihlalo sakhe emoteni agade kuyo, okubalwa ngobukhulu baleyo mota lenani labantu abebekuyo. Umehluko yiwona owongekiweyo, njalo ubalwa kumgibeli lakumtshayeli.
impact.method2: Lokhu kuyisilinganiso. Sibala imota eyodwa ngokubhukha ngakunye, kungelani lezihlalo zayo; asibali ukuphambuka okuncane komtshayeli esiya endaweni yokuthathwa; njalo sicabanga ukuthi umgibeli ubengatshayela ngenye indlela. Nxa ubuzathatha ikombi kumbe ibhasi, wonge okuncane kulalokhu.
